title: Choosing Not to Retaliate
paragraphs: Ketika seorang pesaing menyebarkan informasi menyesatkan tentang bisnis kecilnya secara daring, Faiz merasakan dorongan kuat untuk merespons secara publik dengan komentar yang sama kerasnya, mengungkap kelemahan pesaingnya sendiri. Sebaliknya, ia mengambil waktu sehari untuk menenangkan diri sebelum merespons, akhirnya memposting koreksi yang tenang dan faktual tentang bisnisnya sendiri tanpa langsung menyerang pesaing yang memulai konflik itu.

Beberapa pelanggan mengirim pesan pribadi kepadanya setelahnya, menyebutkan bahwa responsnya yang terukur, dibandingkan nada agresif pesaingnya, sebenarnya meningkatkan kepercayaan mereka pada bisnisnya secara signifikan. Faiz kemudian memberi tahu mitra bisnisnya bahwa merespons dengan menahan diri, alih-alih membalas permusuhan dengan permusuhan, melindungi reputasinya jauh lebih baik daripada perdebatan publik yang memuaskan namun sembrono.
answerKey: When a competitor spread misleading information about his small business online, Faiz felt a strong urge to respond publicly with an equally harsh comment exposing the competitor's own flaws. Instead, he took a day to calm down before responding, ultimately posting a calm, factual correction about his own business without directly attacking the competitor who had started the conflict. Several customers privately messaged him afterward, mentioning that his measured response, compared to the competitor's aggressive tone, had actually increased their trust in his business considerably. Faiz later told a business partner that responding with restraint, rather than matching hostility with hostility, protected his reputation far better than a satisfying but reckless public argument would have.
